::: {.justify}
I build data platforms that scale. Currently a Data Engineer at [F1RST (Grupo Santander)](https://www.santander.com/), where I design and maintain production pipelines with PySpark, Databricks, and Delta Lake -- from ingestion to governance. I hold both Databricks Data Engineer certifications (Professional + Associate) and lead initiatives around data quality, CI/CD with Asset Bundles, and Unity Catalog adoption.

I also teach at the [Faculty of Economic Sciences (UdelaR)](https://www.fcea.edu.uy/), covering Data Science, Machine Learning, Monte Carlo Simulation, and Numerical Methods. I genuinely enjoy helping others grow in the data space -- whether it's mentoring junior engineers at work or sharing what I learn through my blog and podcast, [Spark de Ideas](https://open.spotify.com/show/20WqZma0iLDYbg9wAEfv0w).

On the open-source side, I'm the author of [metasurvey](https://metasurveyr.github.io/metasurvey/), an R package for reproducible survey processing currently under review at [rOpenSci](https://github.com/ropensci/software-review/issues/752). It's my way of bridging data engineering and research infrastructure for Latin America.
:::
